stories.title: When Zero Was Born in India
stories.description: An ancient Indian guru explains how zero was conceived in India and transformed human understanding.

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of an ancient Indian guru (around 65–70 years old) walking slowly and directly toward the camera along a stone corridor inspired by Nalanda University. Male, long white and grey beard, deeply lined face, serene and wise eyes, high forehead, calm spiritual authority. Wearing simple saffron and off-white robes, rudraksha beads around the neck, holding palm-leaf manuscripts. He is clearly speaking while walking, lips articulating speech, mouth and jaw moving naturally, eyes engaging directly with the camera. Front-facing camera only. Character always faces directly toward the camera. Chest and face square to the camera at all times. No side view. No profile view. No over-the-shoulder angle. Avoid side angle, avoid profile view, avoid cinematic side shot, avoid shoulder turn, avoid angled face.
